test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: From the given options, identify the sentence which is in the positive degree.

options.text: I have a greater idea in this regard.
His brother is an intelligent boy.
She is the most beautiful girl of the class.
They are playing hockey with longer sticks.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **positive degree** is used to describe a quality without making any comparison, such as simply stating a fact or characteristic.
 
• In the sentence "**His brother is an intelligent boy**," the adjective "intelligent" is in the **positive degree** as it simply describes his brother without comparing him to anyone else.
 
• The other options use comparative or superlative degrees: 
 
 
• **Option 1:** "Greater" is a **comparative degree**, indicating a comparison of two things.
 
• **Option 3:** "Most beautiful" is a **superlative degree**, indicating the highest degree of beauty among a group.
 
• **Option 4:** "Longer" is a **comparative degree**, comparing the sticks to others.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"His brother is an intelligent boy."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **positive degree** simply describes a quality without comparing it to others (e.g., smart, beautiful, tall).
 
• The **comparative degree** is used to compare two things (e.g., smarter, more beautiful, taller).
 
• The **superlative degree** is used to compare more than two things and shows the highest or lowest degree of a quality (e.g., smartest, most beautiful, tallest).
